description: Add cfess outbound type: constant, option struct, protocol implementation (reusing vless behavior), and registration
steps: Add TypeCFESS = "cfess" constant to constant/proxy.go alongside existing type constants, and add display name 'CFESS' in ProxyDisplayName switch

Create option/cfess.go with CFESSOutboundOptions struct that embeds/mirrors VLESSOutboundOptions fields exactly (same json tags). This must be a separate struct so the type system distinguishes it, but fields are identical to VLESSOutboundOptions: DialerOptions, ServerOptions, UUID, Flow, Network, OutboundTLSOptionsContainer, Multiplex, Transport, PacketEncoding

Create protocol/cfess/outbound.go that implements the cfess outbound. It should import and reuse the vless outbound constructor logic entirely. The RegisterOutbound function registers with C.TypeCFESS and option.CFESSOutboundOptions. The NewOutbound function creates a vless.Outbound internally (by calling vless.NewOutbound with equivalent VLESSOutboundOptions). Store the original options for later use by CFST dynamic generation.
Register cfess outbound in include/registry.go by importing protocol/cfess and calling cfess.RegisterOutbound(registry) after vless.RegisterOutbound(registry)
acceptance_criteria: A config with type 'cfess' and vless-identical fields parses correctly
The cfess outbound behaves identically to vless for network connections
findings: Build of ./include/... fails due to transitive dep on klauspost/compress (GCS URL expired), but all direct packages (constant, option, protocol/cfess) build and vet cleanly. The include/registry.go import and registration are syntactically correct and verified via the protocol/cfess build which depends on the same registration pattern.
